summary: Roadmap Step 15: design-only acceptance/contract for the future Validation-Pilot Gate, automation/acceptance/validation-pilot-gate.yaml, following the REG-CANDIDATES-design / NEXT-EXP-REVIEW-design / AUT-VPG-design / DASH-S8-design precedent (a design memo/spec commit with no gate code, no validator, no test, no generated review, and NO real pilot proposal for AFAC or any other candidate). Explicitly clarified relationship to the existing, still-unimplemented AUT-VPG task (automation/acceptance/val-pilot-gate.yaml): AUT-VPG is a future EXECUTING skill (runs export_probability_predictions.py --split val + analysis, computes a numeric AUROC/recall gate); this new gate is a READ-ONLY reviewer of a WRITTEN PILOT PROPOSAL that never runs code or touches val/test data, sitting strictly upstream of any such execution. Defines: (1) purpose -- answers only 'is this human-selected candidate specified clearly and safely enough to be proposed for a validation-only pilot?', explicitly never scientific-success guarantee, run authorization, queue entry, held-out-test access, frozen-protocol use, or final scientific approval; (2) workflow relationship (Brainstorm Checker -> dashboard review -> human selects one REVIEW candidate -> human authors a pilot proposal -> this gate -> human approval -> later controlled queue/execution) with an explicit rule that candidate rank/REVIEW status is never sufficient readiness by itself -- the gate re-resolves the candidate's current state itself; (3) a full pilot-proposal schema (proposal_id, selected_candidate_id, research_question, hypothesis, claimed_material_difference, prior_negative_evidence_refs, goal_id, dataset_id, model_or_method_scope, allowed_data_split restricted to validation_only/training_and_validation only, explicit_prohibition_on_held_out_test_access, pilot_size_and_bounded_scope, seed_plan, success_criteria, failure_and_stop_criteria, metrics_to_inspect, permitted_output_paths, expected_artifacts, provenance_requirements, compute_or_runtime_limits, sequential_execution_requirement, dependencies, unresolved_scientific_questions, required_human_approvals, claim_boundaries) plus an explicit list of forbidden proposal content (runnable commands, execution authorization, queue-entry fields, held-out-test references, multiple candidates in one proposal); (4) nine SEPARATELY reported gate dimensions (scientific_specification, material_difference, data_readiness, split_safety, protocol_readiness, practical_readiness, resource_boundedness, provenance_readiness, human_approval_readiness) -- never collapsed into one score; (5) three gate outcomes (READY-FOR-HUMAN-APPROVAL, NEEDS-REVISION, BLOCKED) with BLOCKED > NEEDS-REVISION > READY precedence mirroring the Brainstorm Checker's own force_no_go > cap_at_review > may_permit_go ordering, and the mandatory exact phrase 'Suitable for human pilot-approval review only.' plus an explicit non-authorization statement on every READY outcome; (6) 14 hard BLOCKED rules (unresolved candidate, candidate verdict NO-GO, dataset unavailable/aspirational, no_experiment_allowed split, held-out-test tuning/comparison/access implied, test-data use without a real accepted protocol_id, missing required material difference when prior negative evidence exists, unbounded/multi-experiment proposals, runnable commands or execution/queue authorization present, missing provenance/output plan, unresolved/stale source references, protected-registry/queue mutation requests); (7) 11 NEEDS-REVISION conditions for incomplete-but-potentially-viable proposals (vague research question/hypothesis, missing success/stop criteria, missing seed plan, material difference stated but scientifically unreviewed [status stated_unverified, mirroring the Brainstorm Checker's own status vocabulary, never itself certified sufficient], unresolved practical scope/artifacts/resource limits, insufficiently explicit validation-only boundaries); (8) READY conditions requiring ALL of: candidate resolves and is not NO-GO, validation-only split, no held-out-test access, all references resolve, bounded+sequential pilot scope, explicit success/stop criteria, complete provenance/output/artifact plans, material-difference requirements satisfied AT THE PROPOSAL LEVEL (stated_unverified is sufficient for READY only when disclosed with a corresponding required human-approval step -- the gate never itself certifies sufficiency), disclosed (not resolved) unresolved-questions/required-approvals fields, and no execution/queue content anywhere; (9) source-resolution policy: the gate re-resolves (never caches) automation/registry/experiment_candidates.yaml, automation/reviews/next_experiment_review.yaml, goals.yaml, datasets.yaml, reference_evidence.yaml, experiment_identity.yaml, paper_registry.yaml, frontier.yaml, artifact_manifest.csv, and accepted protocol-freeze records, with an explicit must_not_modify list covering every one of those sources plus any acceptance contract; (10) safety boundaries mirroring every prior read-only checker in this repo (no subprocess/shell/network, no runnable command construction, no training/validation/evaluation/export/threshold-selection, no held-out-test read, no experiment_queue.yaml modification, no execution approval, no candidate-verdict/ranking modification, no registry/acceptance-contract modification) with the gate's only permitted write target being its own future designated review output file; (11) an explicit design-deliverable boundary listing exactly what this contract does and does NOT create, and future task boundaries documenting VALIDATION-PILOT-GATE-design (this step, unregistered in tasks.yaml per the now four-times-confirmed design-only precedent) vs the future VALIDATION-PILOT-GATE implementation task and its likely dependencies (NEXT-EXP-REVIEW, REG-CANDIDATES, REG-PAPERS, REG-GOALS, REG-DATASETS, REF-EVID, REG-EXPERIMENT-ID), explicitly naming AUT-VPG / protocol-freeze / experiment-queue / dashboard rendering as separate downstream systems this layer never touches or implies authorization for. YAML parsing verified (python yaml.safe_load succeeds; 26 top-level keys). Precedent inspection re-confirmed: grep of automation/tasks.yaml for VALIDATION-PILOT-GATE returns zero matches, consistent with REG-CANDIDATES-design/NEXT-EXP-REVIEW-design/AUT-VPG-design/DASH-S8-design all using an unregistered '-design'-suffixed task_id -- update_dashboard.py's verification ledger processes any done-receipt's task_id whether or not it is registered in tasks.yaml. No gate implementation, validator, test, pilot proposal (for AFAC or any other candidate), experiment_queue.yaml entry, experiment command, execution script, protocol-freeze record, or experiment result was created. automation/registry/experiment_candidates.yaml, automation/reviews/next_experiment_review.yaml, and every other read-only authoritative input listed in section 10 were NOT modified -- confirmed via git status --short showing exactly one new untracked file and zero modified tracked files at claim time.

commands_run.cmd: python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('automation/acceptance/validation-pilot-gate.yaml', encoding='utf-8'))" -> YAML parses OK, 26 top-level keys
grep -c VALIDATION-PILOT-GATE automation/tasks.yaml -> 0 (confirms no tasks.yaml entry exists or is required for this design-only step)
git status --short -> exactly one new untracked file (automation/acceptance/validation-pilot-gate.yaml); zero modified tracked files

next_action: Use the corrected --approve CLI to approve VALIDATION-PILOT-GATE-design (it will bind to this exact claim). Implementation (gate script + validator + tests + pilot-proposal template + automation/tasks.yaml registration) is a separate, later, explicitly-approved step.
